genxml.title: control bits and clock-control fields of the PCF8584 I2C-bus controller
genxml.doc: Bit values and field codes of the Philips PCD8584 / PCF8584 I2C-bus controller, the part each Hub uses to reach the module system controller on the management bus. The register selection is set by control bits, not by offsets, so the table of selections is in docs/pcf8584.md. Each value is the chip's public register layout as summarised in the source notes; the chip sheet itself was not read in this pass, so every item is inferred.
